Good to know

A few questions, answered

Planning should feel clear and personal. Here are the things couples most often ask before we begin.

Most couples reserve their date 10 to 16 months ahead. Smaller weekday celebrations and portrait sessions often have more flexibility.

Yes. I photograph celebrations throughout the country and accept a considered number of destination weddings each year. Travel details are tailored to your plans.

Your complete gallery is typically ready within eight to ten weeks. A small preview arrives sooner, so you can revisit the feeling while it is still fresh.

Absolutely. Albums are designed in the studio, printed on archival paper and finished by hand in linen or leather chosen to suit your story.

Every wedding collection includes planning guidance, timeline support, edited high-resolution photographs and a private online gallery. Coverage and album options vary by collection.
